The '''octuptarra virus''' (also called the '''clone disease''') was one of several pathogens created by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] experimenters during the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The virus targeted the specific genome of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces. The Confederacy installed the virus in aerosol canisters placed within the heads of [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra combat tri-droids]], which would make [[Death/Legends|suicide]] attacks on the heart of enemy infantry formations, releasing a spray of the contagion. The Republic soon developed an antidote for the virus, but the campaign led to the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] being nicknamed "virus droids."

At the end of the war, octuptarra droids carrying the pathogen were part of a Confederate [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the battle, traces of the virus from destroyed droids that had fallen into the lowest levels of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|planetwide city]] mutated into a form that infected the [[Shashay]] and other avian species, leading to an outbreak of molting.
